provenance.extraction: Curated, byte-accurate original English text from the nested, base64-encoded 2022 BF1 sgtext ZIP CSVs for the nine now-playable quests. Source punctuation/grammar deliberately retained.

missions.name: Basics of Battle
missions.description: It's time to discuss basic combat techniques!

missions.name: Element & Skill
missions.description: Memorize the strengths and weaknesses of each elements and how to trigger the Brave Burst!

missions.name: Start of Adventure
missions.description: Your journey as a Summoner traveling across Grand Gaia has begun! Go forth, and don't forget what Tilith taught you!

missions.name: Monsters of the Prairie
missions.description: The calm grasslands keep on going.The monsters here are just right for a beginner.Keep moving forward.

missions.name: Guardians of the Prairie
missions.description: You can see a rocky mountain faintly on the horizon. Tilith is waiting at the "Cave of Flames" just beyond here.

missions.name: Cave of Dancing Flames
missions.description: The magma flowing within this cave gives off an intense heat. The enemies in this cave have the power of fire.

missions.name: Wielder of the Fire
missions.description: Continue deeper into the Cave of Flames. Beings who control fire are waiting ahead.

missions.name: The Thief's Hideout
missions.description: You've come far, but there's still no exit in site. There are supposed to be bandits in this area.

missions.name: The Blazing Beast
missions.description: Looks like you'll be able to leave this cave soon, but there seems to be something sinister awaiting you at the end.
